scripts.build: npm run build -w @bingoblitz/shared && npm run build -w @bingoblitz/api && npm run build -w @bingoblitz/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @bingoblitz/shared && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test:integration: npm run build && vitest run --config vitest.integration.config.ts
scripts.dev:api: npm run build -w @bingoblitz/shared && npm run dev -w @bingoblitz/api
scripts.dev:web: npm run build -w @bingoblitz/shared && npm run dev -w @bingoblitz/web
